methodology: Forward copy test records a signal only when at least two qualified consensus traders show recent position activity within 60 minutes. Entry is the market outcome price observed by this tracker, not the traders’ historical execution price. Consensus invested/current holding values are reported from open-position snapshots and are not the paper test’s P&L. Settlement requires an explicitly closed/resolved market and terminal outcome price. SELL prints are observations, not proof of full exits; partial exits and fees/slippage are not modeled.
